en.shortDescription: Premium GL.iNet KVM over IP: Wi-Fi 6, 2.22-inch touchscreen and 4K HDMI loop-through.
en.description: The GL.iNet Comet Pro (GL-RM10) is the step-up Comet for KVM that has to work anywhere: Wi-Fi 6 next to Gigabit Ethernet (with automatic failover between the two), a 2.22-inch touchscreen for the IP address and quick setup, and an HDMI output so the local monitor keeps working while you control the machine remotely. Video goes up to 4K@30fps with hardware H.264 encoding, plus 32 GB eMMC and power control through an ATX board or Fingerbot.
useCases: Server rooms and racks without spare cabling

zh.shortDescription: GL.iNet 高端 KVM over IP：Wi-Fi 6、2.22 英寸触摸屏、4K HDMI 环出。
zh.description: GL.iNet Comet Pro（GL-RM10）是 Comet 的进阶版，适合需要灵活部署的场景：除千兆网口外还支持 Wi-Fi 6（两者可自动切换备份），配备 2.22 英寸触摸屏用于查看 IP 与快速设置，并带 HDMI 输出，远程控制的同时本地显示器照常使用。视频最高 4K@30fps，硬件 H.264 编码，32 GB eMMC，可通过 ATX 板或 Fingerbot 控制电源。
highlights: Wi-Fi 6 + 千兆以太网自动备份
useCases: 布线不便的机房与机柜
